description: This file defines the EnvironmentStatisticsProvider class which implements IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider and gathers runtime environment statistics such as CPU usage, memory usage, and available memory. It uses system diagnostics, event listeners, and filters to provide these metrics, and includes internal classes for event listening and Kalman filtering.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider
classes.description: Provides environment statistics such as CPU and memory usage, utilizing event listening and filtering with internal Kalman filters for smoothing data.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider.EventCounterListener
classes.description: An internal event listener class for capturing CPU usage metrics from system runtime events.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider.DualModeKalmanFilter
classes.description: Implements a dual-mode Kalman filter that tracks signals with slow and fast response regimes, used for smoothing CPU, memory, and available memory metrics.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider.DualModeKalmanFilter.KalmanFilter
classes.description: A struct representing a Kalman filter state used within the dual-mode filter to estimate signals.

methods.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing memory collection, counters, and filters.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Collects and returns current environment statistics including CPU and memory usage, applying filters for smoothing.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the event listener resources.

methods.name: EventCounterListener.OnEventSourceCreated
methods.description: Enables event listening for system runtime events, specifically for CPU usage counters.

methods.name: EventCounterListener.OnEventWritten
methods.description: Handles incoming event data to extract CPU usage metrics.

methods.name: DualModeKalmanFilter.Filter
methods.description: Filters an input measurement through either slow or fast regime Kalman filters based on signal direction.

methods.name: KalmanFilter.SetState
methods.description: Sets the current estimate and error covariance of the Kalman filter.

methods.name: KalmanFilter.Filter
methods.description: Performs a Kalman filter update step given a measurement and process noise covariance.
